_meta.purpose: Committed reference for the AC6 structures audit (real-universe-overlay-2026-07-12, design D6). scripts/audit-structures.mjs checks the shipped deep-sky objects against these published values and emits structures-audit.md.
_meta.profileReference: Each profile row carries the published galactic longitude l (deg), latitude b (deg), and heliocentric distance d (kpc) that the KnownObjectProfiles galacticPos was hand-derived from, plus a published physical radius radiusPc (pc). The audit recomputes the galactocentric position from (l,b,d) with the Sun at (8.0, 0.025, 0) kpc and compares it to the stored galacticPos — a genuine self-consistency check that catches a mis-derived position (precedent: the IC434/M78 fix).
_meta.coordinateConvention: x_towardGC = d*cos(b)*cos(l); y_rotation = d*cos(b)*sin(l); z_NGP = d*sin(b). game.x = 8.0 - x_towardGC; game.y = 0.025 + z_NGP; game.z = y_rotation. (Matches scripts/process-harris-catalog.mjs and the profile comments.)
_meta.sizeNote: radiusPc is a published physical radius (angular extent x distance, or a catalog half-mass/optical radius). Nebular and cluster 'size' is genuinely fuzzy and source-dependent, so the size tolerance is a factor of 2 — it guards against gross (>2x) errors, not fine disagreement.
_meta.sources: Positions l/b/d: SIMBAD / NED object records and the standard Messier/NGC/IC catalogs (the same values recorded in each profile's comment). Physical sizes: published angular diameters x distance (SEDS Messier database, NED). Globular structural radii: Harris (2010) Milky Way globular cluster catalog, Part III (data/catalogs/harris_globular_clusters.dat).

globulars.note: Positions are self-consistency-checked: recompute game xyz from (l, b, rSun) and compare to the shipped globular-clusters.json xyz (which came from the Harris heliocentric X/Y/Z columns). Tolerance absorbs the catalog's 1-decimal X/Y/Z rounding.
globulars.radiusDerivation: radiusKpc = r_c * 10^c (tidal radius, arcmin) * 2.90888e-4 (arcmin->rad) * rSun_kpc. Harris Part III columns c (King concentration) and r_c (core radius, arcmin).
